title: Why Do Languages Differ?
hook: People far apart invented different word-systems.
narration: People far apart invented different word-systems.
This 3D Short is only about this: Why Do Languages Differ.
Each language is a toolkit for thinking.
Let me show you that in 3D.
Learning one more toolkit grows your world.
Watch this next bit closely. This is why it happens.
Malayalam, English, and thousands more are all human.
So the idea is simple: cause, then effect.
Remember: People far apart invented different word-systems.
The pictures today are a new ear world. Not yesterday's film.
That is the whole idea, in one short 3D film.
Stay to the end. The last shot is the takeaway for why do languages differ.
If a grown-up is with you, pause and tell them the cause in one sentence.
Tomorrow a brand new 3D film. Same curious science. Brand new pictures.
